title: Checkpoint I: Nearby Repeated Events
prerequisite: Lessons 1–5. The relevant pattern is intentionally not announced.
hints: When an event repeats, only its most recent earlier index can produce the smallest distance to the current index.
Store the latest index for each event in a Map and compare the current index with that stored index.
Return true when the distance is at most maxDistance; otherwise update the event to the current index and continue.
